## 9. Podcast Highlights

- **Date:** 2026-05-26  
  **Source:** [AI Daily Brief — Beating the AI Doom Cycle](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TGQ0FtvAPK4)  
  **Summary:** The episode focused on AI inequality driven by scarce frontier-model access, compute constraints, stricter KYC, security controls, and government allocation of advanced capability.  
  **Available now:** The risk is already visible in access gating, enterprise pricing tiers, and compute bottlenecks.  
  **How to act:** Track model-access terms, compute-provider constraints, and export/security rules before committing AI roadmaps that depend on unrestricted frontier access. Build fallback plans using smaller proprietary models, open-weight models where suitable, and multi-provider routing.  
  **Why it matters:** The strategic issue is not only model capability; it is who can reliably obtain, afford, and legally deploy that capability.
